description: This file defines classes and types related to test suites and test cases in a testing framework, including Suite and TestCase classes, with methods for managing test hierarchy, serialization, and test outcome evaluation.

classes.name: Base
classes.description: Base class for test suite and test case, holding common properties like title.

classes.name: Suite
classes.description: Represents a test suite, containing nested suites and test cases, with methods for hierarchy management and serialization.

classes.name: TestCase
classes.description: Represents an individual test case, with properties for execution, results, and metadata.

methods.name: titlePath
methods.description: Returns the hierarchical path of titles leading to the suite or test.

methods.name: allTests
methods.description: Recursively collects all test cases within the suite.

methods.name: outcome
methods.description: Determines the test case outcome based on its results.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Returns true if the test outcome is expected or flaky.

methods.name: _appendTestResult
methods.description: Adds a new test result entry to the test case.
